[THE PREVENTATION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS (SIND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1923.]
[4th October, 1923]
An Act further to amend the Prevention of Cruelty to
Animals Act, 1890.
1. Short title.----This
Act may be called the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (**[Sind] Amendment) Act, 1923.

sections.description:
Amendment of section II of XI of 1890

SIND ACT NO
SIND ACT NO. IX OF
1923*
[*For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G. 1923 e. V,
pp 7-8; and for Proceeding in Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates,
1923, Vol. X.]
[THE PREVENTATION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS (SIND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1923.]
[4th October, 1923]
An Act further to amend the Prevention of Cruelty to
Animals Act, 1890.
2. Amendment of section II of
XI of 1890.---In section II of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act,
1890, after the words "offence to" the words "abandon, turn loose
or" shall be insered, XI of 1890.
